nozzle.title: Supersonic Nozzle
nozzle.subtitle: Applied Fluid Mechanics Personal Project
nozzle.description: Engineered a highly precise, equation-driven 3D CAD model of a converging-diverging (de Laval) rocket nozzle. Utilized SolidWorks to construct complex surface sweeps and revolves based on theoretical aerodynamic profiles.

itemEB.title: Global Carbon Systems Dashboard
itemEB.subtitle: Personal Thermodynamic Project
itemEB.description: A computational modeling platform engineered to track the depletion of the world's remaining CO₂e budget before surpassing the +2.0ºC thermodynamic threshold. By translating massive global emissions datasets into a real-time interactive dashboard, this project demonstrates my ability to analyze complex macro-energy systems and develop robust, data-driven engineering software.

item0.title: Digital Twinning for Efficient Path Finding Algorithms to Reduce Energy Consumption with Autonomous Mobile Robots
item0.subtitle: University Project, Digital Twinning
item0.description: Engineered a high-fidelity Digital Twin framework for Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs) to optimize fleet navigation, safety, and operational efficiency. By bridging physical hardware with complex Gazebo simulations via real-time MQTT and ROS synchronization, I established a live, bidirectional testbed for advanced path-planning and collision-avoidance algorithms (SLAM, A*, DWA). This system acts as a robust pipeline for virtual commissioning, significantly reducing physical deployment times while validating tangible improvements in path execution and fleet utilization.

item2.title: Sight Reading Application
item2.subtitle: University Project, Software Design
item2.description: Knowin' Notes is an application that aids users in learning to sight read for piano. Users achieve their sight reading ambitions by correctly identifying musical notation (notes, chords, and arpeggiated patterns) with a MIDI keyboard or their device screen. As the user's sight reading skills improve, they will be prompted with notation of increasing difficulty. Those who teach music, music students, and pianists that want to improve their sight reading abilities are demographics for which we expect Knowin' Notes to have the greatest impact.

item3.title: Encrypted Messaging Application
item3.subtitle: University Project, Computer Networks
item3.description: Developed a secure messaging application using cryptographic algorithms like RSA, AES, and SHA-256, ensuring data integrity and confidentiality. Built with Java and Computer Networks frameworks, the project was rigorously tested for resilience against network vulnerabilities.

item4.title: Self-Leveling Robot
item4.subtitle: University Project, Digital Signal Processing & Electronics
item4.description: Developed a robotic platform to balance a steel bearing ball under various perturbations. Contributed to project planning, troubleshooting, and iterative prototyping in a team environment to optimize performance.
